## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

# Loading Data

Loading metadata

```{r}
clinical_df <- readRDS("data/clinical_df.rds")
```

Loading raw counts

```{r}
counts_df <- readRDS("data/counts_df.rds")
```

Loading tpm

```{r}
tpm_df <- readRDS("data/tpm_df.rds")
```

# Set up

```{r}
gc()
```

Loading libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

# Familiarizing with data

**Count data**

```{r}
head(counts_df)
```

```{r}
dim(counts_df)
```

**Clinical data**

```{r}
head(clinical_df)
```

```{r}
dim(clinical_df)
```

Count data and clinical data have the same number of samples

```{r}
colnames(clinical_df)
```

-   Patient ID A unique identifier assigned to each patient.

-   BOR Best Overall Response Describes how well a patient's cancer responded to treatment.

-   TMB Tumor Mutational Burden Measures the number of mutations in a tumor, usually expressed as mutations per megabase (mut/Mb).

-   sample_id Sample ID A unique identifier for a biological sample collected from a patient

# Filter to overlapping samples

```{r}
all(clinical_df$sample_id == colnames(counts_df))
```

The sample id-s from the two datasets are in order

# Converting BOR

Converting BOR into factor

```{r}
clinical_df$BOR <- as.factor(clinical_df$BOR)
```

```{r}
levels(clinical_df$BOR)
```

```{r}
table(clinical_df$BOR)
```

# **Build the DESeq2 dataset and run the differential expression analysis**

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_df,
                              colData = clinical_df, 
                              design = ~ BOR)
```

Remove low-expression genes

```{r}
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep,] 
```

```{r}
sum(!keep)   # Number of genes removed
```

```{r}
sum(keep)    # Number of genes retained
```

Differential gene expression analysis

```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r}
result <- results(dds)
```

```{r}
resultsNames(dds)
```
